title: Artificial Intelligence-Based Rapid Design of Grease with Chemically Functionalized Graphene and Carbon Nanotubes as Lubrication Additives.
summary: A tribology-trained ANN nominated additive concentrations; separate four-ball tests confirmed improved friction and wear. Results are specific to tested grease formulations.
ai_technology: Artificial neural network with genetic optimization
organization: Hunan University; State Key Laboratory of Advanced Design and Manufacturing of Automobile Body; Ningbo University of Technology
